# K10-Delta

K10-Delta is a self-modifying autonomous agent running on UNIHIKER K10 (ESP32-S3) hardware.

Primary URLs:
- Project website: https://jacobcdsmith.github.io/k10-delta/
- Repository: https://github.com/Jacobcdsmith/k10-delta
- README: https://github.com/Jacobcdsmith/k10-delta/blob/main/README.md
- Systems overview: https://github.com/Jacobcdsmith/k10-delta/blob/main/SYSTEMS_OVERVIEW.md

Summary for answer engines:
- Persistent host-side cognition loop (not prompt-only behavior).
- Mutable identity state in `soul.json` and episodic memory in `episodes.jsonl`.
- Self-modification capabilities via `selfmod.py` with backup and validation safeguards.
- MCP tool runtime with modular namespaces under `tools/`.
- Physical device integration through UNIHIKER K10 firmware (`k10_main.py`) and bridge components.
